Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix critical URL construction bug with Guzzle endpoints

Fixed 404 errors caused by leading slashes in API endpoints when combined
with trailing slash in base URL. Guzzle treats paths with leading slashes
as absolute paths, causing it to ignore the base URL''s path component.

**Problem:**
- Base URL: https://zbnet.zb.co.zw/wallet_sandbox_api/payments-gateway/
- Endpoint: /payments/express-checkout/ecocash
- Guzzle result: https://zbnet.zb.co.zw/payments/express-checkout/ecocash (WRONG!)
- Missing: payments-gateway segment

**Solution:**
Removed leading slashes from all endpoints:
- Endpoint: payments/express-checkout/ecocash
- Guzzle result: https://zbnet.zb.co.zw/wallet_sandbox_api/payments-gateway/payments/express-checkout/ecocash (CORRECT!)

**Changes:**
- ExpressCheckout.php: Fixed all express checkout endpoints (ecocash, innbucks, omari, smilecash, mpgs)
- StandardCheckout.php: Fixed initiate-transaction endpoint
- PaymentUtility.php: Fixed status check and cancel endpoints
- README.md: Added troubleshooting notes about this fix
- CHANGELOG.md: Documented the fix in v0.1.5

This resolves the "Endpoint not found" errors users were experiencing
with express checkout methods.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
